examples/origin_neg_capture.sober:8:25: error: the shared cache policy 'Fresh' meets the credential source 'std/http.Authorization' in one route — a response that depends on Authorization / Cookie must not be stored by a shared cache — it would be served to other users (language.md 12 節「出所の依存」); use http.Private / http.NoStore for this route, or move the credential read out of it (Analyzer)
